review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: The increasing people's dissatisfaction come from the prevalence of commercials with negative social impacts even though it has positive economic effects. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Some people argue that advertising can bring undeniable benefits. Firstly, advertising with creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand, leading to spending power increases, in result it would encourage more employment opportunities, greater state revenues through taxation can would make a stronger economy. For example, some e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital sector. Furthermore, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design to make it an important driver of economic activity.

However, other people argue that advertising has negative social consequences, owing among being constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions to foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people, in particular, feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook and then lead to frustration when buy they cannot afford them, advertising even promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, I strongly believe that both views come certain extent advertising contributes to social dissatisfaction but even play a crucial role in economic development.

completion.comment: Bài có đủ bốn phần trên ảnh.

review.overall: Bài của em có đủ bốn đoạn và dùng được ví dụ e-commerce, nhưng lỗi câu dày khiến người đọc phải đoán quan hệ ý. Em cần viết lại cẩn thận, nhất là câu mở bài và các cụm ‘in result’, ‘owing among being’; không nên chép khung khi chưa kiểm tra cấu trúc.

paragraphs: The prevalence of commercials can create dissatisfaction among viewers, although advertising also has positive economic effects. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Advertising with creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand. This raises spending power and encourages production. As a result, more employment opportunities are created and state revenues increase through taxation, supporting a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting both their sales and the digital retail sector. Furthermore, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media, and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. It constantly shows images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, and luxury possessions, which can foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people in particular may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. When they cannot afford these items, frustration can result. This experience can strengthen materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, I strongly believe that both views are valid to a certain extent. Advertising contributes to economic development, while it can also contribute to social dissatisfaction.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
